item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera lights a diya filled with ghee during a festival. The ghee near the wick melts and turns to vapour, and the vapour then burns with a flame. Which statement about the burning diya is correct?

options.A: Only physical changes take place, because the melted ghee can solidify again.
options.B: Only a chemical change takes place, because a flame is seen.
options.C: The diya undergoes both a physical change, when ghee melts and evaporates, and a chemical change, when the ghee vapour burns to form new substances.
options.D: No change takes place, because the ghee is used up slowly.
